Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled under our warranty rather than standard returns! We cover manufacturing and material defects free of charge with a repair or replacement.
Normal returns require items to be unused with original tags and packaging within 45 days. However, for damaged or defective items, you just need to share your order number and a photo of the damage so we can get a replacement or resolution sorted out for you.
